name: waaait
description: A time-capsule social app: bury a letter on a map for a friend to dig up.
detail: Bury a letter at a spot on the map, and a friend follows warmer-colder hints to dig it up. Waaait also has time-locked letters that stay sealed until a chosen date, and Ask, where one honest answer gets opened on your own time.

Log — a rolling paper you fill together

name: comecame
description: Watch other countries live and keep a record of the trips you take.
detail: Browse other countries' live webcam views on a map, sorted by category like city, nature, or beach, and log the scenes you watch as part of your own travel record.

name: film cam
description: A film-camera feel with random 1-12 hour development times.
detail: Shots develop after a random wait of 1 to 12 hours, weighted toward the shorter end, recreating the anticipation of waiting on real film.

name: daydaylaw
description: Paste your lease's special clauses and get legal checkpoints and case law before you sign.
detail: A Korean real-estate legal guide: browse recent policy trends, paste a lease or sale contract's special clauses to see related checkpoints and case law, and look up common disputes and the statutes behind them. Not legal advice.
